# `vox-skill-discovery`

**Crate:** `vox-skill-discovery` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Local on-demand discovery + dedup engine: repeated .vox blocks, installed-skill dedup, MCP SSOT drift. Advisory only.

## Crate Overview

Local, on-demand discovery + dedup engine. Mines repeated `.vox` code blocks,
dedups installed skills, and flags MCP↔skill SSOT drift. Advisory only — it
never installs, executes, or publishes.
